column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# Two surfaces, two phases. The design session (shape) is direct manipulation on a
# canvas this plugin serves; the real-component preview (decide) renders variants on
# the project's own dev server. A running session owns the preview surface, so the
# preview yields to it; the preview's other yield is the fallback its README states —
# a greenfield dir or a stack with no Vite/Laravel host hands the decision to
# taskmaster's shell mockup. /design-studio:preview is a dispatcher — every rule lives
# in the real-preview skill — so both rows claim ONE territory and the command yields.
